text:
elsa: started a small docs PR to add a migration note for Nebula3b embedding sharding + clarify the "max_shard_size" default. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4510. want quick sanity check on bench numbers and the SDK snippet changes for v4.0.

rafael: quick context: some customers saw degraded recall when switching to shard_size=256 vs 1024, probably due to truncation during windowing. we should recommend 512 as the safe default for now and show a short example.

jun: can you paste the bench numbers? i can format a tiny table. also note that SDK v4 renamed `embed_shard` -> `embedding_shard_size`. docs should use the new param to avoid confusion.

elsa: thanks. raw numbers from a quick run on c5g (cpu embed shard test) batch=8, k=10 recall@10: 
- shard=1024: 0.87
- shard=512: 0.86
- shard=256: 0.80
latency (median, ms): 
- 1024: 95ms
- 512: 110ms
- 256: 160ms
I uploaded CSV & plot: https://drive.google.com/nebula3b-embed-shard.csv and https://drive.google.com/nebula3b-plot.png

maya: nit: the PR still links to an older bench doc under /benchmarks/ that we removed last month. update the internal link to the new bench index: /benchmarks/embeddings/nebula3b.

rafael: also add a short migration snippet for Dedicated customers: how to pin a variant and test shard settings via the `/variants` API. small curl example should be enough.

jun: here's a compact SDK v4 snippet suggestion (js):
```js
const emb = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: "nebula3b",
  input: texts,
  embedding_shard_size: 512, // v4 param name
});
```

elsa: good. i'll swap to that and add a short table: recommended shard sizes vs tradeoffs (1024: highest recall, best latency; 512: balanced; 256: low memory but recall drop).

maya: add an explicit compat note: some CPU-optimized quant variants disable async shard prefetching which increases latency for small shards. one-liner under Compatibility.

docbot: docs-lint: failed 6a9 missing bench link update. preview blocked until link updated.

elsa: i'll update links and push. thanks for the flag.

rafael: if you can also include the command to run a quick recall check (script snippet) that makes it easy for SEs to reproduce, that would be handy.

elsa: added a tiny python repro snippet and updated links + SDK snippet. pushed new commit. preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4510/ 

jun: reviewed, left one tiny formatting nit in the table. otherwise lgtm.

maya: +1

rafael: +1, merge after CI.

elsa: merging after CI passes. follow-up: i'll file a short follow-up to track adding an automated regression check for shard sizes to the benchmark suite.
